decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding Condition 2, details in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council as Local Planning Authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with such approved details:Further details, including plans for all elevations and samples, of the windows.

Condition : 4 - Wallis House shall not be occupied until the proposed Operating and Maintenance Manual and details of how the same shall be made available to the occupiers of the building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved Operating and Maintenance Manual shall then be made available to the occupiers of Wallis House as approved.
description: Alterations to windows to existing Wallis House building following planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 08/12/06. (Planning and Listed Building Applications)
